name: Linux - PCI Req 10 - Privileged Activity - New
title: Linux - PCI Req 10 - Privileged Activity - New

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux* sudo
| extract "(?<process>\w*):\s+(?<src_user>[^ ]+?)\s+:.+?USER=(?<dest_user>[^ ]+?)\s+" nodrop
| where process="sudo"
|where if ("{{src_user}}" = "*", true, src_user matches "{{src_user}}") AND if ("{{src_host}}" = "*", true, src_host matches "{{src_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_host}}" = "*", true, dest_host matches "{{dest_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_user}}" = "*", true, dest_user matches "{{dest_user}}") AND if ("{{process}}" = "*", true, process matches "{{process}}")
|count as eventCount

_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux* sudo
| extract "(?<process>\w*):\s+(?<src_user>[^ ]+?)\s+:.+?USER=(?<dest_user>[^ ]+?)\s+" nodrop
| where process="sudo"
| timeslice 5m
|where if ("{{src_user}}" = "*", true, src_user matches "{{src_user}}") AND if ("{{src_host}}" = "*", true, src_host matches "{{src_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_host}}" = "*", true, dest_host matches "{{dest_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_user}}" = "*", true, dest_user matches "{{dest_user}}") AND if ("{{process}}" = "*", true, process matches "{{process}}")
|count as eventCount by _timeslice

_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux* "sudo"
| parse regex "\S*\s+\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<_sourceHost>\S*)\s" nodrop
| _sourceHost as dest_host
| extract "(?<process>\w*):\s+(?<src_user>[^ ]+?)\s+:.+?USER=(?<dest_user>[^ ]+?)\s+" nodrop
| parse "ruser=* rhost=* user=*" as src_user, src_host, dest_user nodrop
| parse regex "COMMAND=(?<command>[^$]*)$" nodrop
| where process="sudo"
| timeslice 1s
|where if ("{{src_user}}" = "*", true, src_user matches "{{src_user}}") AND if ("{{src_host}}" = "*", true, src_host matches "{{src_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_host}}" = "*", true, dest_host matches "{{dest_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_user}}" = "*", true, dest_user matches "{{dest_user}}") AND if ("{{process}}" = "*", true, process matches "{{process}}")
|count as eventCount by _timeslice, dest_host, src_user, dest_user, src_host, command
| fields -eventCount
| sort by _timeslice

_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux* sudo
| parse regex "\S*\s+\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s+(?<_sourceHost>\S*)\s+" nodrop
| _sourceHost as host
| extract "(?<process>\w*):\s+(?<src_user>[^ ]+?)\s+:.+?USER=(?<dest_user>[^ ]+?)\s+" nodrop
| where process="sudo"
|where if ("{{host}}" = "*", true, host matches "{{host}}") AND if ("{{src_user}}" = "*", true, src_user matches "{{src_user}}") AND if ("{{src_host}}" = "*", true, src_host matches "{{src_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_host}}" = "*", true, dest_host matches "{{dest_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_user}}" = "*", true, dest_user matches "{{dest_user}}") AND if ("{{process}}" = "*", true, process matches "{{process}}")
|count as eventCount by host
| top 10 host by eventCount

_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux* sudo "user NOT in sudoers"
| parse regex "\S*\s+\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s+(?<_sourceHost>\S*)\s+" nodrop
| _sourceHost as dest_host
| extract "(?<process>\w*):\s+(?<src_user>[^ ]+?)\s+:.+?USER=(?<dest_user>[^ ]+?)\s+" nodrop
| parse "TTY=* ; PWD=* ;" as tty, workingdirectory nodrop
| parse "USER=* ;" as dest_user nodrop
| where process="sudo"
| fields dest_user, src_user, dest_host, tty, workingdirectory | fields -_raw
|where if ("{{src_user}}" = "*", true, src_user matches "{{src_user}}") AND if ("{{dest_host}}" = "*", true, dest_host matches "{{dest_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_user}}" = "*", true, dest_user matches "{{dest_user}}")
|count as eventCount

_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux* sudo
| extract "(?<process>\w*):\s+(?<src_user>[^ ]+?)\s+:.+?USER=(?<dest_user>[^ ]+?)\s+" nodrop
| where process="sudo"
|where if ("{{src_user}}" = "*", true, src_user matches "{{src_user}}") AND if ("{{src_host}}" = "*", true, src_host matches "{{src_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_host}}" = "*", true, dest_host matches "{{dest_host}}") AND if ("{{dest_user}}" = "*", true, dest_user matches "{{dest_user}}") AND if ("{{process}}" = "*", true, process matches "{{process}}")
|count as eventCount by dest_user, src_user
| top 10 dest_user, src_user by eventCount
